resources.string: Sync favorites & pinned comps across devices
Immediate alerts for new LIVE and PBE game patches and balance hotfixes.
Alerts when new S-tier compositions surge in win rate.
Persistent control notification while the in-game favorites overlay bubble is active.
Notifications when a new version of TFT\'s Helper is available to update.
Star a composition and tap the pin icon to display it here during live matches.
Background Alerts: 15m Worker & Alarm • Auto App Update on Open • Manual Comp Sync

TFT\'s Helper isn\'t endorsed by Riot Games and doesn\'t reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing Riot Games properties. Riot Games, and all associated properties are trademarks or registered trademarks of Riot Games, Inc.
Riot Terms of Service & Fair Play

Read-only reference companion built strictly under Riot Games Legal Jibber Jabber and TFT Third-Party Policies: zero memory reading, zero game hooks, zero screen scraping, zero input automation, and no banned augment win-rate overlays. Team codes use standard manual clipboard paste into Riot\'s built-in Team Planner.
No ads, no third-party ad tracking, and optional Google Sign-In solely to sync your favorite compositions and preferences across devices.

Data We Collect:
• Optional Google Account ID (only if you sign in) to store your favorited compositions and alert preferences in Firebase Firestore.
• Local-only preferences (theme, overlay opacity, cached meta snapshots) stored on your device.

Data We Never Collect:
• No advertising identifiers, no behavioral ad tracking, no location data, and no reading of other apps or game memory.

Your Controls:
• You may use the app entirely in Guest Mode without creating an account.
• You can clear local app data or permanently delete your cloud account and synced Firestore records at any time from this screen.
